h: Atiku inaugurates ADC presidential campaign council as Tinubu heads to Kaduna
p: Atiku Abubakar has reportedly inaugurated the ADC presidential campaign council in Abuja, on the same weekend the APC begins its re-election campaign in Kaduna. APC campaign chief Abdulaziz Yari has played down the threat from both Atiku and Peter Obi.
more: Yari says Port Harcourt and Maiduguri are the next stops on Tinubu's campaign trail.
The ADC council has reportedly criticised Kwankwaso for urging Atiku to step aside for Obi.
